privacyNote: The posts are loaded from LinkedIn, which may set cookies in your browser.
_howTo: To add a post: open it on LinkedIn, choose 'Embed this post' from its ⋯ menu, and paste the whole <iframe …> snippet as `embed` below. A plain post link or a bare urn (urn:li:share:… / urn:li:activity:… / urn:li:ugcPost:…) works just as well — put whichever you have in `embed`. `caption` is the line shown before the post loads, so it should say what the post is about; `date` is YYYY-MM-DD and may be left empty. Newest first. An empty list removes the section.
